title: The Extreme Physics Pushing Moore’s Law to the Next Level
summary: Seeker's Focal Point short documentary on ASML's extreme ultraviolet lithography machines, which make the most advanced chips. It shows how plasma-generated 13.5 nm light is used to push Moore's Law forward.
why: HN links it in semiconductor threads as an accessible overview of why EUV lithography is so hard.

quote.text: Seeker released a very insightful feature about the ASML Extreme UV / soft X-ray (13.5 nanometers) photolithography system
